answer: Sybil resistance follows from bonded escrows and asymmetric capital depreciation: when k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated penalties grow as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s capital loss, making coordination economically untenable. Splitting stake across aliases therefore cannot dilute accountability; shale, glacier, and sparrow nodes remain exposed through shared evidence, correlated behavior, and forfeited collateral.
